entities.name: UniProt B0JWV0
observations: Reviewed Microcystis aeruginosa ATP synthase subunit delta; input sequence is an exact 182-aa sequence match (100% identity and coverage).
Forms part of the peripheral stalk linking CF0 and CF1 in F-type ATP synthase; reference annotation places it at the thylakoid membrane as a peripheral membrane protein.
Input sequence-derived estimates: 19,628.6 Da, pI 6.34, instability index 31.14, GRAVY 0.179.

entities.name: F-type ATP synthase
observations: Rotary ATP synthase couples proton or sodium-gradient-driven ion translocation with ATP synthesis; the δ-subunit is a peripheral-stalk component, not the catalytic ATP-forming subunit.
